items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: And actually in high school I met Dot, who became my wife

ctx.x: Do you recall any of the kinds of bands that might have played at social functions at Hamilton?

I remember one winter carnival. The pianist, whom I later met in Denmark, oh I can’t remember his name but he was the leader. Wilcox. Eddie Wilcox. And actually in high school I met Dot, who became my wife, and she came up for house parties. And I remember dancing with her because it wasn’t my class’s event. I think it might have been the senior ball or something, and it was winter carnival I think. And there was Omer Simeon in the band playing saxophone. And I knew it and didn’t dare — I was too shy, I didn’t go…
You know we — I know exactly what you’re saying because I had a similar instance —
